incident-bot: [ALERT] P95 error-rate spike and 502s observed for /v1/generate on dedicated-eu-1. Auto-created incident INC-2026-1432. Paging: @sophie (oncall). Logs: https://internal.logs/INC-2026-1432 :rotating_light:

sophie (oncall): ack, I'm on it — taking primary. Initial symptom: external 502s from runner processes, host-gpu-3 showing memory pressure. Will gather quick impact list.

maria (eng-sre): oncall, pulling ssh + docker logs. Early view: repeated KV cache allocations then OOM kill on runner-worker-7. Could be quantized model cache leak after recent kernel update. I’ll attempt a rolling restart of runner-worker-7 and scale the pool by +2 nodes as a fallback.

ryan (support): observed customer reports: Asterian Financial and VeraPay both opened high-priority tickets noting payment request failures. Asterian is enterprise-high-touch (SLA 99.9%). They'll expect proactive comms.

lina (acct-mgmt): confirming — Asterian (acct-id: AST-9876) is currently failing authorizations; their AM on-call is me (lina@redwood.com) and primary technical contact is support@asterian.com / +1-415-555-0199. VeraPay (acct-id: VPA-4412) has some transactions retried; AM is marco (cc’ed). Please include tailored impact statements; they will want ETA.

sophie (oncall): Drafting internal and customer messages below. Please review before I post/update status page.

statuspage-bot: Suggested public status page update (draft):
```
Title: Degraded response for text-generation on EU dedicated pool
Impact: Customers using dedicated-eu-1 may experience increased errors and elevated latency for text-generation endpoints. We are investigating and implementing mitigations.
Current status: Investigating
What we're doing: Restarting affected workers, scaling capacity, and routing affected customers to fallback pools where necessary.
ETA: We will provide an update within 30 minutes.
```

ryan (support): Proposed tailored customer notif for Asterian Financial (please shorten if needed):
"Asterian team — we’ve detected a service degradation affecting text-generation calls for your dedicated instance (AST-9876). You may see 502/500 errors and failed authorizations intermittently. Our engineers are actively mitigating by restarting impacted workers and routing traffic to a fallback pool to restore service. We will update you within 30 minutes. For urgent issues, contact lina@redwood.com or +1-415-555-0199."

ryan (support): Proposed tailored customer notif for VeraPay: 
"VeraPay — we are investigating elevated error rates on dedicated-eu-1 affecting some payment-related calls. Temporary retries may occur; we’re applying mitigations now (worker restarts + temporary routing). We’ll update when traffic is stable. For questions, reach out to marco@verapay.com or support@redwood.com."

maria (eng-sre): Mitigation plan I'm executing now (ordered):
1) Scale dedicated-eu-1 pool +2 workers (estimated 90s to register).
2) Rolling restart of runner-worker-7 (to stop OOM/kv leak).
3) Apply per-account routing rule to route AST-9876 and VPA-4412 to shared-fallback-usw with model variant quantized-v1 and reduced concurrency (10rps) to keep latency stable.
4) If errors persist, enable autoswap to smaller model variant and open emergency rollback for recent kernel patch.

Command snippets:
```
# scale pool
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood.local/pools/dedicated-eu-1/scale" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"delta":2}'

# apply routing rule for account
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood.local/routing/rules" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"account":"AST-9876","target":"shared-fallback-usw","model":"quantized-v1","concurrency_limit":10}'
```

devops-bot: Scaling request accepted, queue id q-8812. Estimated completion 70-100s.

sophie (oncall): executing routing after scale completes. @lina please stand by to send the Asterian note once I confirm failover. @ryan will coordinate the VeraPay message.

maria (eng-sre): scale completed, workers registered. Rolling restart started on runner-worker-7; seeing reduced memory allocations in realtime. Applying routing rules for AST-9876 and VPA-4412 now.

devops-bot: Routing rule applied successfully (rule id r-5573) — traffic for AST-9876 and VPA-4412 now flowing to shared-fallback-usw.

maria (eng-sre): After routing, error rate dropped from 18% -> 1.8% for those accounts. Logs show graceful fallbacks; no OOMs post-restart. Monitoring for 10 minutes to confirm stability.

sophie (oncall): Action items:
- @lina send tailored Asterian message (use draft above).
- @ryan send VeraPay message.
- @maria continue 10m watch and post a follow-up when stable.
- I'll update the public status page to: Identified -> Mitigated in 5m if metrics hold.

lina (acct-mgmt): sending Asterian note now. Copying AM & engineering liaison.

ryan (support): sending VeraPay note now.

statuspage-bot: public status updated to Identified (draft changed to: Mitigated pending verification).

maria (eng-sre): 10m watch complete — error rate steady at ~1.5%, latency within SLO for fallback. Marking incident as mitigated; will keep monitoring and schedule RCA.

sophie (oncall): closing loop: Incident INC-2026-1432 moved to Mitigated. Next: RCA runbook scheduled, include kernel patch rollback checklist and KV cache instrumentation. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
